events.title: Central Bank adds selective credit controls (wave 1)
events.description: On 7 December 2020 the Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan) set loan-to-value limits of 60% for first and 50% for further home loans to corporate buyers, 60% for third and further homes, and 65% for land loans, effective 8 December.

zh.description: 2020 年 12 月 7 日，中華民國（臺灣）中央銀行規定：公司法人購屋貸款的成數上限，第一戶為 6 成、第二戶以上為 5 成；第三戶以上購屋貸款為 6 成；土地抵押貸款為 6.5 成。自 12 月 8 日起生效。

events.title: House and Land Consolidated Income Tax takes effect
events.description: On 1 January 2016 the House and Land Consolidated Income Tax took effect. Gains from selling houses and land acquired from 2016 onward are taxed on the actual gain, at rates set by the holding period. The tax is administered by the Ministry of Finance.

zh.title: 房地合一所得稅開始實施
zh.description: 2016 年 1 月 1 日，房地合一所得稅開始實施。2016 年起取得的房屋和土地，出售時依實際獲利課稅，稅率依持有期間而定。這項稅由財政部主管。

events.title: House and Land Consolidated Income Tax 2.0 takes effect
events.description: On 1 July 2021 amendments to the House and Land Consolidated Income Tax took effect. They extended the holding periods that qualify for lower tax rates on gains from selling houses and land. The tax is administered by the Ministry of Finance.

zh.title: 房地合一所得稅 2.0 開始實施
zh.description: 2021 年 7 月 1 日，房地合一所得稅的修正條文開始實施，延長了出售房屋和土地時適用較低稅率所需的持有期間。這項稅由財政部主管。

events.title: Equalization of Land Rights Act amendments take effect
events.description: On 1 July 2023 amendments to the Equalization of Land Rights Act took effect. They limit the resale of pre-sale housing contracts, require a permit for private legal persons buying housing, and set fines of up to NT$50 million.

zh.title: 平均地權條例修正條文開始實施
zh.description: 2023 年 7 月 1 日，平均地權條例修正條文開始實施：限制預售屋合約轉售、私法人購買住宅須經許可，並訂定最高新臺幣 5,000 萬元的罰鍰。

events.title: House Tax Act amendments (holding tax 2.0) take effect
events.description: On 1 July 2024 House Tax Act amendments took effect. The rate range for non-owner-occupied homes rose from 1.5-3.6% to 2-4.8%, and holdings are counted nationwide instead of per city. The first bills under the new rules were issued in May 2025.

zh.title: 房屋稅條例修正條文（持有稅 2.0）開始實施
zh.description: 2024 年 7 月 1 日，房屋稅條例修正條文開始實施。非自住住家用房屋的稅率範圍從 1.5% 至 3.6% 提高為 2% 至 4.8%，持有戶數改為全國合併計算，而不是各縣市分別計算。依新規定開徵的第一批稅單在 2025 年 5 月發出。

Amounts were higher for ages 20-35, newlyweds and families with children. First payments were made in October 2022.

events.title: Magnitude 7.1 earthquake in Hualien County

zh.title: 花蓮縣發生規模 7.1 地震
zh.description: 根據中央氣象署，2024 年 4 月 3 日 07:58，花蓮縣壽豐鄉發生規模 7.1 地震。臺北市和新北市記錄到的最大震度為 5 弱。

sources.label: Central Weather Administration earthquake report No. 019, 3 April 2024
